interactionContract.continuationCeiling: CAP-12 recovery and CAP-13 semantic review share one append-only continuation unit. The second request hands off instead of scheduling another turn.
interactionContract.schemaStability: Off, shadow, and enforced phase modes retain one provider-visible tool schema; phase policy is enforced at the tool-call boundary without setActiveTools churn.
interactionContract.unknownSyntax: Unsupported or unresolved language syntax remains non-proof-capable and cannot promote advisory acceptance into enforcement or recovery.
interactionContract.independentRollback: PIAGENT_ACCEPTANCE_ASSURANCE=off closes CAP-11 and dependent CAP-13; PIAGENT_SEMANTIC_REPAIR=off closes CAP-13 only. Neither switch can promote authority, and resume records one durable new-attempt disposition.
interactionContract.helperOwnership: CAP-14 recommend remains zero-turn, CAP-14 on retains one read-only automatic dispatch, and CAP-15 cannot add a second dispatch. Existing one-writer and owned-work ceilings remain unchanged.
